caseNameFull: Ada C. Mongrain v. W. H. Aaron

opinions.text: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Oklahoma. Sub*615mitted October 21,1920. Decided December 6, 1920. Per Curiam. Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6,1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726. Mr. Preston A. Shinn for plaintiff in error. Mr. Nathan B. Williams and Mr. George B. Denison for defendants in error.
